item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Brændende kærlighed, Danish 'burning love', buttery mashed potatoes topped with crispy bacon and parsley. Served with pickled red onions and pickled beetroot on the side. (6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Spanish paella with rice, chicken, sausage, fish and blue mussels, topped with parsley and peas. Served with roasted padrón peppers, ensalada mixta and lemon on the side. (3+5+14+15) GREEN DISH: Dish GREEN DISH: alubia paella with rice, lima beans and vegetables, topped with parsley and peas. Served with roasted padrón peppers, ensalada mixta and lemon on the side. (15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Roast turkey cuvette with potatoes and corn tossed in butter and finely cut chives. Served with a fresh herb salad in vinaigrette. (6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Fried mushroom patty with potatoes and corn tossed in butter and finely cut chives. Served with a fresh herb salad in vinaigrette. (6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Danish pork patty with new potatoes and a silky honey-mustard sauce. Served with a fresh green salad. (1+6+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Vegetable patty with new potatoes and a silky honey-mustard sauce. Served with a fresh green salad. (1+6+11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Chicken massaman curry with vegetables, peanuts and coconut milk, served with fluffy jasmine rice and topped with Thai basil. Served with ajad, fresh coriander, lime and chilli oil on the side. (3+4+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Tofu massaman curry with vegetables, peanuts and coconut milk, served with fluffy jasmine rice and topped with Thai basil. Served with ajad, fresh coriander, lime and chilli oil on the side. (3+4+7+11+15)
